[WP] The world around you freezes, all is silent... You hear a click from behind.

"Freeze, Blarton" Is what the time patrol officer shreeks as it cocks it's laser blaster. "Drop the counterfeit time passports!"

"Go ploof yourself you feathered fascist! The passports should be for everyone and not just the finches!! Time is not just for the birds, but for man and birds both!!!"

the patrol bird demands, "Dont use that language around me, you filthy human"

Blarton then spins around and countetfit passports spill out of her folded arms to reveal she holds a rusted photon grenade in one of her hands! "I'll say whatever the ploof I want. If you shoot me then we will all get blown halfway to Zoobult!"

The uniformed finch sees the pin from the grenade on the ground and uncocks itsblaster with its other foot.

"Thats more like it, you beak face. How about you go back where you came from and go munch on some flack seeds and take a relaxing bath in a fountain." Blarton smiles and starts to back up.

The officer lands on a nearby ledge and looks left and right really fast and blinks several times. Then tries to reason with blarton. "The war is over, Blarton! We Finches only ask for peace!" He chirps softly, "Think of your family. If you kill me then you know what will happen to your family. Just take a breathe and think about what you're doing! We can talk about this."

"All my brothers were killed in the battle of Wamplefez when your kind invaded in the year 5076. You killed my father for his article he wrote on your torture tactics and then you used those tactics on my mother, to see if she knew any other journalits with any other knowelege. Her head was left on our window seal and a frown was pecked into her face!"

"We know you have a child, Blarton" The finch pulls out a photo with his beak of a young boy blowing the candles out on a birthday cake, from his human flesh jacket.

Blarton feared the worst and had to get a closer look at the photo, since it was proportional to what a photo size should be for a house finch.

As Blarton leaned in closer, the finch got a closer look at the photon grenade and began inching his foot closer to his blaster holster.

"Thats right, Blarton. We know all about you."

As Blarton finally is able to focus on who is in the photo, the finch leaves the photo on the table and begings to hover, with his wings fluttering and draws his blaster silently.

Blarton finally sees this isn't her son. Just some random child and looks up to only be staring into the barell of a A471 Katpouvean chrome double action blasterd and the last thing she sees is a flash.

The finch lands on the shoulder of Blarton's headless body and pulls a radio out of his blood covered uniform and speaksinto it. "Central, this is agent 745-C. Please report with cleanup to Sector Hernf."

As a team from the Clean Up Brigade flock into the scene, the blood covered agent is greeted by his commanding officer.

"Good job rookie!" He chirps with praise. "I got word of the situation but can't understand how you knew the photon grenade was a dud."

The agent blinks a bunch and looks left and right really fast, "The rust, sir. It covered the release mechanism from that thing. I thought the perpetrator was going to call me on my bluff about it's kid. After all my weeks of tracking this counterfeiter I never got my eyes on the kid. Just heard rumors it had one." The agents foot reaches into the the back pocket of Blarton's stiff body. "Can you give me a hand sir? You may want to see this". Both struggle to pull the get the folded paper put of her pocket. Once they got the help from 4 of the Cleaners, out popped a photo of a young boy in the arms of Blarton.

"Find him and see if he knows if there are any other counterfeiters." The ranking Finch commands.

"Yes sir. The young ones are very easy to make talk. But right now I need to find a fountain and take a bath."

My great grand father lived to be 97 and died just a few years ago. Many people live to be in their 80s. With current technology and advances in medical technology, how old could an 18yo in the US or Europe live to be under average or slightly above average circumstances? Assuming they don't get murdered or something.
What is a reasonably age for a currently 18yo person to live to be? Accounting for advances in medical technology and such.

There are a number of contributing factors, including gender, diet, genetics and lifestyle that determine your over all life expectancy. Here is the Actuarial Life Table from the U.S. Social Security Administration that gives an example of average life expectancy, based on 2010 statistics. Remember it is an average, factoring in people who die young and old. http://www.ssa.gov/oact/STATS/table4c6.html

According to government statistics, an average 18 year old has a life expectancy of an additional 63.59 years - that is to say the average 18 year old will have his/her 18 years plus 63.59 more for a total life expectancy of 81.59 years.
